text:
anya (docs): Pushed a draft PR consolidating rate/quota examples, dashboard links, and SDK snippets. https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2460 :wave:

sam (eng-platform): Nice. Quick question: are the examples using token-normalized units per hour or per minute? Need to be explicit for billing alignment.

anya (docs): I added both: an hourly example for billing docs and a 1m moving-average variant for ops. Each is clearly labeled.

mike (product): Use hourly as primary in public docs; keep 1m in the ops section. Also add a one-line explainer about visible allocation = committed tier + burst.

lia (devex): Heads-up: update SDK header name to X-RW-Usage (we removed X-Usage-Tokens). Can you include a mapping note for older SDKs?

anya (docs): Done. Example curl I included:

```
# last hour, per-minute buckets
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Usage: project=acme,env=prod" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1m"
```

sam (eng-platform): Add Grafana panel permalink (panel id 42) and a troubleshooting note for double-counting when migrating canary -> stable (routing headers/meter_key mistakes).

anya (docs): Added both: permalink to panel 42 and a troubleshooting callout: "If totals look doubled, verify routing headers and unique meter_key per route."

lia (devex): Please include a tiny JS SDK snippet showing parsing of series points for 1h vs 1m aggregates. Suggested code:

```
const res = await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h',{ headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'X-RW-Usage': 'project=acme,env=prod' }});
const body = await res.json();
console.log(body.series[0].points.map(p => p.value));
```

anya (docs): Included under "SDK snippets" and linked to docs/units.md for normalized token units. Also added a short paragraph about fallback model routing changing per-model meter attribution.

mike (product): Looks good. After CI, tag me and Sam for review. Also open a follow-up issue for a test prompt set that stresses token churn for Optimize recommendations.

deploy-bot: docs-ci started for PR #2460  build 912 in progress.

anya (docs): CI passed. Tagging reviewers @sam (eng-platform) @mike (product). :rocket:
